question_protocol.selection: Seeded first 3 unused canonical rules with English counterparts, if available, then seeded remaining unused searchable Korean rules to 12; metadata only, no question outcomes.
question_protocol.supported: two distinct main body articles per source, selected by SHA256(seed + source id + article id); one explicit source question, one paraphrase; one English question per available counterpart
question_protocol.controls: 8 new out-of-domain and at least 3 ambiguous questions; no answer values in questions
question_protocol.timing: write labels after source implementation freeze; run final retrieval once; no tuning after results
question_protocol.limits: internal author, related rule families may overlap; not external audit
question_protocol.fallback: If fewer than two substantive owning articles exist, select distinct numbered clauses or headings, then substantive paragraphs before addenda by the same seeded hash. Record the fallback; never replace a source due to retrieval difficulty.
question_protocol.paired_final_comparison: After freezing final implementation and writing/auditing labels, run the starting baseline binary and final binary once each on these same questions. Neither result may influence this cycle implementation, lexicon, thresholds or labels.
